messages:
Harper G: Quick: small hotfix sprint for launch SEO after last night's content push. Two blockers: a stray legacy slug still returning 200, and FAQ schema missing on Variant B. Need redirects + schema check + a quick sitemap resubmit. Can someone pick up redirects?

Noah W: I'll take redirects. Will generate a compact CSV and push to S3. Plan: 1) 302 for 24h to monitor, 2) swap to 301. I'll add a 'note' column for legacy traffic sources.

Maya L: I can patch the schema. Variant B missing FAQPage and breadcrumbList. I'll add Event + FAQPage JSON-LD to landing and Article+mainEntity to the two posts. Pasting tiny JSON-LD snippet for review: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I join the webinar?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Register on the landing page and check your email for the link."}}]}```

Harper G: nice. Also add Open Graph image metadata on the landing so social shares pick up the new hero. Confirmed slug list: /plume-launch, /plume-benchmarks, /plume-best-practices. Legacy slugs reported: /plume-old, /plume-preview-2026.

Noah W: Sample CSV rows: `source,target,type`
`/plume-old,/plume-launch,302`
`/plume-preview-2026,/plume-launch,302`
I'll upload to s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/plume-hotfix.csv and then run `/deploy redirects plume-hotfix`.

deploy-bot: When ready run `/deploy redirects plume-hotfix` — I'll report status back here. :gear:

SEO-Bot (olivia): Quick audits to run post-deploy: 1) curl the canonical header + check rel=canonical in HTML; 2) run Mobile-Friendly test; 3) check Search Console coverage after sitemap resubmit. Also flag: duplicate meta-description between benchmarks and best-practices, consider tweaking.

Maya L: I'll push schema patch and run the structured data tester. Will paste results screenshot link to the sheet.

Noah W: Uploaded CSV and hit deploy. Command: `/deploy redirects plume-hotfix` (ran at 3427778985).

deploy-bot: Deploy started for plume-hotfix at 3427778986. Will post success/failure.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete (success) at 3427779002. 302 rules active; reminder: switch to 301 after 24h if metrics OK.

SEO-Bot (olivia): Post-deploy checks: rel=canonical present on all three pages, FAQ JSON-LD detected on Variant B landing, but breadcrumbList missing on /plume-benchmarks — Maya, can you add? Also submit sitemap: https://www.redwood.ai/sitemap.xml updated and pushed to Search Console.

Maya L: will add breadcrumbList to benchmarks and re-run tests now.

Harper G: acceptance: redirects live (even as 302), schema present on landing + two posts, OG image added, sitemap resubmitted. Everyone drop a 1-line status in the planning doc by EOD. If any 24h metric spike, we'll revert 302s. Thanks y'all! :sparkles:
